bodyHtml:
Greenspector is a subsidiary of the D.R.I. Group

D.R.I. (Digital Rural Informatique) is a sovereign French cloud host with the best PUE on the market (1.13). With 80 employees and €80M in group revenue, DRI brings together complementary expertise around responsible digital.

The group also includes:

  • Syloe — DevOps specialist
  • Data Inceptio — AI training
  • Swiftask — AI developer
  • IA Souveraine — sovereign multi-AI no-code portal

The DRI Group brings together complementary, independent expertise: sovereign hosting, agentic AI, data, open source, ecodesign, consulting and training, while delivering secure, high-performance and sustainable digital transformation.

Each entity contributes to a coherent, integrated ecosystem, giving public and private organisations technological sovereignty, skills development and controlled environmental impact.

Group vision & positioning

The DRI Group embodies sovereign digital: technological independence, performance and environmental responsibility. A credible French alternative to international solutions.

Eco-responsibility

Datacenters without air conditioning, impact measurement and systematic ecodesign.

Digital excellence

Operational excellence, guaranteed availability, continuous innovation.

Sovereignty

100% French infrastructure and data, full control of the technology chain.

Who are we?

  1. French pioneer in responsible digital : 15 years of expertise measuring and reducing the carbon footprint de vos of your digital services, with an experienced engineering team.
  2. Trusted partner for real-world measurement: energy consumption, performance and environmental impact of every mobile/web app, on physical devices.
  3. Unique Device Lab in Europe : over 100 smartphones & tablettes Android et iOS, de plusieurs générations — au moins un haut de gamme, un milieu de gamme, un entrée de gamme — for 100% reliable testing.
  4. SaaS solution self-service : launch your ecodesign campaigns in a few clicks and track KPIs (kWh saved, CO₂ avoided, load times).
  5. Strategic partnership with DRI — ISO 14001 certified sovereign host: eco-responsible, secure infrastructure and the best market PUE: 1.13.
  6. Responsible mobile AI : accélération du développement IA tout en maîtrisant l'impact énergétique. Réservation du banc de test pour les campagnes de décharges batteries des applications avec IA embarquées.
  7. Concrete benefits with Greenspector Studio :
    • Reduced datacenter energy consumption
    • Reduced battery drain
    • Shorter initial load, refresh and total journey times
    • Anticipated compliance with Green-IT, RGESN et RGAA
    • Stronger brand image through publishing the Greenspector eco-score, a recognised reference in software ecodesign
  8. Solution adopted by over 100 organisations publiques et privées — over 165 million users de smartphones.

Want to turn your applications into environmental assets? Contact us.

How does Greenspector contribute to the common good?

Our vision: contribute to a virtuous and responsible digital world.

Our mission: "From device to application, measure frugality and performance of your digital services."

Our 4 values: ACIE

A — Act for the environment, the planet and the common good

C — Contribute to frugal, sovereign and high-performance digital

I — Innovate to deliver fast, user-friendly and cost-effective measurement solutions

E — Listen to the market, clients, employees and stakeholders

Our CSR policy

1. Reduce our clients' environmental impact

Our ambition is to help clients reduce the environmental impact of their digital services. . We work on this every day to offset our own impacts. Over 100 million Europeans have indirectly benefited from our services.

2. Raise awareness of digital impact

Reducing digital impact requires awareness among all industry stakeholders. We regularly speak at schools, meetups and conferences for all profiles: CIOs, POs, designers, webmasters, CSR consultants…

Our shared position with DRI Group companies gives us a wider audience and greater impact. Alliances with Ademe, ADN Ouest, French Telecom Federation, EVEA, I-CARE, Norsys, Constellation and other responsible digital players strengthen visibility. We also raise awareness through our blog and working groups such as Green Code Lab, Green Lab Center and the Green Compagnons network.

3. Identify and share digital frugality best practices

Measuring our clients' applications and websites leads us to identify and recommend best practices. We contribute to GR491, RGESN, 115 web ecodesign best practices and Designers Éthiques frameworks. Our recommendations are backed by concrete measurement feedback. We are also expanding our scope with RGAA support.

4. Expand access to our services for associations

We offer Greenspector Studio at half price to non-profit associations and certain scientific projects (e.g. VU Amsterdam). This is one of the goals of our Mobile Efficiency Index tool.

5. Committed and transparent governance

  • Financial and remuneration transparency
  • Majority-based collegial decisions
  • Remote work for everyone, including interns
  • Autonomy: shared calendars, goal tracking, no time monitoring
  • Half-day birthday leave offered
  • Soft mobility encouraged — partnership with Transway to fund employees' low-carbon mobility

6. Coq Vert BPI certification

Greenspector joins the community of 3,500 committed companies certified Coq Vert BPI to share inspiring environmental best practices.

Their view on Greenspector Studio

François Lankar Applications Manager, Bouygues Telecom

Working on frugality clearly leads to a more performant application.

Julien Azria Digital Front Chapter Leader, Crédit Agricole Technologie & Services

Avec Greenspector Studio, testers can guide developers by identifying regressions or unwanted side effects from a change.
